name: Prayers of Sigmar
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty; Sigmarite prayers may be used in armour.

spells.name: The Hammer of Sigmar
spells.effectSummary: Empowers the priest's weapon for powerful, double-damage close-combat hits.

spells.name: Hearts of Steel
spells.effectSummary: Bolsters nearby allies against fear and improves the warband's Rout tests.

spells.name: Soulfire
spells.effectSummary: Damages nearby enemies; Undead and Possessed suffer a stronger hit.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.effectSummary: Protects the priest from spells until the ward fades.

spells.name: Healing Hand
spells.effectSummary: Restores a nearby warrior and revives friendly models that are stunned or knocked down.

spells.name: Armour of Righteousness
spells.effectSummary: Grants the priest strong armour and immunity to fear for a short time.

name: Necromancy
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Lifestealer
spells.effectSummary: Wounds a nearby living target and temporarily strengthens the Necromancer.

spells.name: Re-Animation
spells.effectSummary: Returns a recently destroyed Zombie to the battle near the Necromancer.

spells.name: Death Vision
spells.effectSummary: Causes fear in the Necromancer's enemies for the battle.

spells.name: Spell of Doom
spells.effectSummary: May inflict an injury on a nearby enemy that fails a Strength test.

spells.name: Call of Vanhel
spells.effectSummary: Gives a nearby Zombie or Dire Wolf an immediate move that can count as a charge.

spells.name: Spell of Awakening
spells.effectSummary: Raises a slain enemy Hero as a Zombie under the Necromancer's control.

name: Chaos Rituals
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Vision of Torment
spells.effectSummary: Stuns or knocks down the closest enemy within range.

spells.name: Eye of God
spells.effectSummary: Once per battle, grants a randomly determined boon or penalty to a nearby model.

spells.name: Dark Blood
spells.effectSummary: Fires a damaging blood attack that also risks injuring the caster.

spells.name: Lure of Chaos
spells.effectSummary: May temporarily seize control of the closest enemy.

spells.name: Wings of Darkness
spells.effectSummary: Moves the caster up to 12 inches and may carry them into a charge.

spells.name: Word of Pain
spells.effectSummary: Inflicts a Strength 3 hit on models close to the caster, without armour saves.

name: Lesser Magic
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Fires of U'Zhul
spells.effectSummary: Hurls a ranged fireball that causes a Strength 4 hit.

spells.name: Flight of Zimmeran
spells.effectSummary: Moves the wizard up to 12 inches and may carry them into a charge.

spells.name: Dread of Aramar
spells.effectSummary: May make a nearby non-Undead, non-fearless enemy flee.

spells.name: Silver Arrows of Arha
spells.effectSummary: Creates magical arrows for a penalty-free volley at one enemy.

spells.name: Luck of Shemtek
spells.effectSummary: Allows the wizard to reroll failed dice until their next turn.

spells.name: Sword of Rezhebel
spells.effectSummary: Summons a powerful weapon that may vanish when the wizard fails a Leadership test.

name: Magic of the Horned Rat
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Warpfire
spells.effectSummary: Projects a short-range blast that hits its target and may scorch a nearby model.

spells.name: Children of the Horned Rat
spells.effectSummary: Once before a battle, summons temporary Giant Rats near the Sorcerer.

spells.name: Gnawdoom
spells.effectSummary: Inflicts numerous weak bites on one nearby target.

spells.name: Black Fury
spells.effectSummary: Lets the Sorcerer charge an enemy and gain extra attacks for that combat.

spells.name: Eye of the Warp
spells.effectSummary: May drive standing models in base contact away and injure them.

spells.name: Sorcerer's Curse
spells.effectSummary: Forces a nearby enemy to reroll successful saves and attacks for a turn.

name: Amazon Rituals
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Singing Wind
spells.effectSummary: Entrances a nearby model, preventing movement and ranged attacks for a turn.

spells.name: Serpent's Strength
spells.effectSummary: Raises the Strength of nearby friendly models for a turn.

spells.name: Wendala's Maelstrom
spells.effectSummary: Creates a storm that makes enemy missile attacks less accurate.

spells.name: Shield of Thorns
spells.effectSummary: Protects the Priestess from ranged and magical attacks; limits the first combat round.

spells.name: The Living Jungle
spells.effectSummary: Sends a poisonous swarm against one nearby model.

spells.name: Siren's Dreams
spells.effectSummary: Weakens enemy Leadership tests for a short time.

name: Norse Runes
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty; runes can be cast in armour and follow Sigmarite prayer casting.

spells.name: Howl of the North
spells.effectSummary: Makes the Shaman immune to missile fire until the winds dissipate.

spells.name: Angvar's Fury
spells.effectSummary: Improves nearby allied warriors' close-combat hit rolls until the next turn.

spells.name: Elvek's Cold Spear
spells.effectSummary: Fires an icy spear that inflicts a Strength 4 hit.

spells.name: Gift of the Fates
spells.effectSummary: Lets the Shaman adjust one die roll by one until their next recovery phase.

spells.name: Kiss of Frost
spells.effectSummary: May knock down a nearby model that fails an Initiative test.

spells.name: Bear's Might
spells.effectSummary: Greatly boosts the Shaman's combat characteristics until the power fades.

name: Dark Magic
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Doombolt
spells.effectSummary: Fires a bolt that can jump between nearby enemies with diminishing Strength.

spells.name: Word of Pain
spells.effectSummary: Weakens one enemy's attacks and may prevent them from charging.

spells.name: Soul Stealer
spells.effectSummary: Can wound a model in base contact and temporarily increase the Sorceress's Wounds.

spells.name: Flamesword
spells.effectSummary: Adds Strength and armour-ignoring hits to a nearby ally's close-combat weapon.

spells.name: Deathspasm
spells.effectSummary: May force the closest enemy to roll on the Injury table; the caster is knocked down.

spells.name: Witch Flight
spells.effectSummary: Moves the Sorceress up to 12 inches and may carry her into a charge.

name: Waaagh! Magic
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Led'z Go
spells.effectSummary: Nearby Orcs and Goblins strike first in close combat while the spell holds.

spells.name: Oi! Gerroff!
spells.effectSummary: Pushes a nearby enemy away and may injure models or terrain it hits.

spells.name: Zzap!
spells.effectSummary: Strikes the closest enemy with several Strength 4 hits that ignore armour.

spells.name: Fooled Ya!
spells.effectSummary: Prevents enemies charging the Shaman next turn or lets them escape combat.

spells.name: Clubba
spells.effectSummary: Creates a temporary, powerful club for the Shaman.

spells.name: Fire of Gork
spells.effectSummary: Fires two bolts of flame at one or two nearby enemies.

name: Lizardmen Spells
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty; these spells may be cast while wearing armour.

spells.name: Chotec's Wrath
spells.effectSummary: Strikes the closest nearby enemy with lightning, more severely if armoured.

spells.name: Sotec's Blessing
spells.effectSummary: Randomly improves one friendly model's combat, toughness, movement, or initiative.

spells.name: Huanchi's Stealth
spells.effectSummary: Lets nearby Skinks in cover hide, even after running or shooting.

spells.name: The Old Ones' Protection
spells.effectSummary: Gives nearby Lizardmen a ward against spells and prayers.

spells.name: Tinci's Rage
spells.effectSummary: Makes one Lizardman frenzied and stronger while the spell is maintained.

spells.name: Itzl's Speed
spells.effectSummary: Grants one Lizardman a short extra move that cannot be used to charge.

name: Shadow Magic
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty; several spells require nearby terrain that can cast a shadow.

spells.name: Pool of Shadow
spells.effectSummary: Lets the caster and nearby allies hide and count as in cover for a turn.

spells.name: The Living Shadows
spells.effectSummary: Strikes a nearby enemy with a Strength 4 hit that ignores armour.

spells.name: Wings of Night
spells.effectSummary: Moves the Shadow Weaver between nearby shadows and may result in a charge.

spells.name: Cloak of Darkness
spells.effectSummary: Conceals the caster from attacks until they attack an enemy.

spells.name: Shadowbind
spells.effectSummary: Restrains an enemy until it passes a Strength test or the spell ends.

spells.name: Shield of Shadow
spells.effectSummary: Gives the caster or a nearby ally an unmodified 5+ armour save.

name: Prayers of Taal
castingRuleSummary: Follow Prayers of Sigmar casting; Taal's Priest does not wear armour.

spells.name: Stag's Leap
spells.effectSummary: Moves the Priest up to 9 inches and may carry them into a Strength-boosted charge.

spells.name: Blessed Ale
spells.effectSummary: Fully heals a nearby model and weakens living enemies close to the Priest.

spells.name: Bear's Paw
spells.effectSummary: Increases the Strength of the Priest or a nearby ally.

spells.name: Earthshudder
spells.effectSummary: Damages enemies touching a nearby building and causes the structure to collapse.

spells.name: Tanglefoot
spells.effectSummary: Slows nearby models as plants and vines erupt from the ground.

spells.name: Summon Squirrels
spells.effectSummary: Sends a swarm against one enemy, inflicting many weak hits without armour saves.

name: Nurgle Rituals
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Daemonic Vigour
spells.effectSummary: Improves nearby Plague Bearers' and Nurglings' Daemonic Aura save.

spells.name: Buboes
spells.effectSummary: May wound one nearby enemy that fails a Toughness test; no armour save.

spells.name: Stench of Nurgle
spells.effectSummary: May reduce the Attacks of nearby living enemies.

spells.name: Pestilence
spells.effectSummary: Hits all nearby enemies with a Strength 3 attack that ignores armour.

spells.name: Scabrous Hide
spells.effectSummary: Grants the caster a temporary 2+ armour save.

spells.name: Nurgle's Rot
spells.effectSummary: May infect enemies in base contact with the caster.

name: Nurgle Rituals (Seer)
castingRuleSummary: Use Nurgle Rituals with the first result replaced by Touch of Onogal.

spells.name: Touch of Onogal
spells.effectSummary: Can infect an enemy defeated by the Seer in close combat, creating a temporary plague servant.

spells.name: Buboes
spells.effectSummary: May wound one nearby enemy that fails a Toughness test; no armour save.

spells.name: Stench of Nurgle
spells.effectSummary: May reduce the Attacks of nearby living enemies.

spells.name: Pestilence
spells.effectSummary: Hits all nearby enemies with a Strength 3 attack that ignores armour.

spells.name: Scabrous Hide
spells.effectSummary: Grants the caster a temporary 2+ armour save.

spells.name: Nurgle's Rot
spells.effectSummary: May infect enemies in base contact with the caster.

name: Shornaal Rituals
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty.

spells.name: Delicious Suffering
spells.effectSummary: May knock down all other nearby models that fail a Leadership test.

spells.name: Dance of the Serpent
spells.effectSummary: Makes nearby enemies less accurate when attacking the Seer in close combat.

spells.name: Endless Torment
spells.effectSummary: Entraps one enemy in ongoing torment while the Seer sustains the ritual.

spells.name: Mystify
spells.effectSummary: Reduces an enemy's Initiative and makes it strike last until it passes a test.

spells.name: A Thousand Voices
spells.effectSummary: Reduces one enemy's Leadership and may end when it resists or the Seer is wounded.

spells.name: Shornaal's Temptation
spells.effectSummary: May take control of one nearby enemy that fails a Leadership test.

name: Tchar Rituals
castingRuleSummary: Roll 2D6 and meet the listed difficulty unless the result is marked Auto.

spells.name: Tchar's Blessing
spells.effectSummary: Forgoes casting in the next battle in exchange for possible post-battle Experience.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.effectSummary: Ends all currently active spells.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.effectSummary: Once before battle, makes a randomly selected enemy Hero miss the next game.

spells.name: Wrath of the Great Eagle
spells.effectSummary: Hits one enemy according to the difference in Experience between it and the Seer.

spells.name: Tchar's Reward
spells.effectSummary: Temporarily increases one characteristic for each ten Experience points.

spells.name: Slave to Chaos
spells.effectSummary: May inflict an armour-ignoring hit and transform a slain enemy into a temporary Horror.
